migration.title: Data Upgrade
migration.subtitle: One-time tool: bring old records up to the current data conventions
migration.explain1: Records created before the latest update are missing some fields. This tool scans orders, shipments and users, then fixes:
migration.fix1: Adds the missing id field inside every document.
migration.fix2: Converts createdBy / updatedBy / archivedBy values that contain an email into the user's uid.
migration.logsNote: The activity log is intentionally immutable, so old log entries are not touched — new entries are already correct.
migration.confirmRun: Apply the fixes to all listed records? This writes to the database.
migration.dryRunNote: Scan only — nothing has been changed yet. Press Apply to write the fixes.
migration.doneNote: Done — all listed changes have been written.

help.title: Help & Guide
help.subtitle: How Lumière Orders works, step by step

s1.title: Collect the orders
s1.body: On the Preparation page: drop the Sllr export file in the import box (everything converts automatically), and add WhatsApp / Instagram orders with the manual form.

s2.title: Review & edit
s2.body: Check the table and edit any order with the pencil button. An order flagged ⚠ needs its governorate fixed before export.

s3.title: Move to Shipments
s3.body: One button moves the whole batch safely to the Shipments page and empties the list for the next day. Nothing is ever deleted in this step.

s4.title: Export the Wassalha file
s4.body: From Shipments: tick specific orders to export only them, or leave everything unticked to export all (respecting the status filter). Then upload the file to Wassalha.

s5.title: Track each order
s5.body: Update the status pill as the order progresses — the history stays here permanently until you delete it.

statuses.title: Order statuses
statuses.preparing: Default after moving — the package is being prepared for the courier pickup.
statuses.shipped: The courier picked it up and it is on the way.
statuses.delivered: Delivered to the customer and COD collected.
statuses.returned: The customer refused or it came back — follow up in the Wassalha settlement.
statuses.cancelled: Cancelled after the move, for any reason.

rules.title: Fixed conversion rules
rules.r1: Weight is always 500 in the export file.
rules.r2: Reference Number is always empty in the export (Wassalha rejects Sllr IDs). The Sllr ID is kept internally for tracking.
rules.r3: Phone numbers are converted to local format (+20… → 0…).
rules.r4: Governorates are converted to Wassalha names (e.g. Sohag → SOUHAGE).
rules.r5: COD equals the order amount for Cash on Delivery, otherwise 0.

rolesSection.title: Roles & permissions
rolesSection.admin: Admin: everything — orders, user management, activity log.
rolesSection.staff: Staff: orders only (add, import, export, delete).

usersSection.title: Managing users
usersSection.u1: Only admins see the Users page.
usersSection.u2: Create a user with name, email, temporary password, and role.
usersSection.u3: Deactivating a user blocks all their access immediately; you can reactivate them anytime.
usersSection.u4: Every action in the system is recorded in the Activity Log with who did it and when.
usersSection.u5: Anyone can change their own password from the key button in the top bar (the current password is required).
